oto.sektor: modern bir spor salonu, ağırlıklar ve koşu bantları
oto.esnaf_tarif: very muscular young Turkish fitness trainer in his late 20s, clean-shaven, short black fade haircut, tight black t-shirt with no logo, whistle around his neck, huge enthusiastic smile
oto.fikir: Cemo yeni yıl kararıyla spora başlar. Antrenör coşkuyla program anlatır; Cemo her harekette bir bahane bulur. Punchline: Cemo'nun tek kaldırabildiği ağırlık kantindeki tost olur, antrenör ona 'protein' diye gülümser.
oto.notlar: Bu skeçte sponsor/reklam yok; sadece temiz mizah.

senaryo.aciklama: Cemo'nun antrenman programı bilimsel 😂 Siz spora ne zaman başlıyorsunuz?

planlar.metin: [excited] Hadi Cemo abi, yirmi şınav! Başla!
planlar.gorsel: A modern gym with dumbbells and treadmills, the trainer clapping his hands, Cemo seen from behind lying flat on a yoga mat.

planlar.metin: [sighs] Hocam, ilk şınavı kafamda yaptım. Yoruldum.
planlar.gorsel: Same gym, Cemo lying face up on the yoga mat, sweating and exhausted, wearing his round glasses and grey flat cap, with his THICK BLACK MUSTACHE clearly visible, his old shoulder video camera next to him; the trainer seen from behind.

planlar.metin: Peki koşu bandı! On dakika, hafif tempo!
planlar.gorsel: Same gym, the trainer pointing at a treadmill, Cemo seen from behind.
Same gym, Cemo on a treadmill walking extremely slowly while eating a grilled cheese toast.
planlar.hareket: Cemo walks very slowly on the treadmill and happily takes a big bite of a toast
planlar.efekt: treadmill motor humming and a crunchy toast bite

planlar.metin: [surprised] Cemo! Koşu bandında tost mu yiyorsun?
planlar.gorsel: Same gym, Levent standing next to the treadmill in disbelief, Cemo seen from behind.

planlar.metin: [excited] Abi, karbonhidrat yüklemesi. Profesyoneller böyle yapıyor.
planlar.gorsel: Same gym, Cemo on the treadmill holding the half-eaten toast like a trophy, Levent seen from behind.
